questions.question: God told Moses to warn Israel not to follow the practices of which two lands?
Why did God tell the Israelites to keep His statutes and judgments?

answers.text: The one who keeps them will live by them
The nations around them will honor them
Their enemies will run away from them

questions.question: God said the land Israel was entering had become defiled. What would the land do to its people?
God gave Israel laws against the sinful practices of Egypt and Canaan. What must happen to anyone who breaks them?

answers.text: Be cut off from his people
Offer a lamb at the altar
Stay outside the camp a week
